transcript.text:
Thank you both for your clarifications. I appreciate the good faith in placing these on the formal record and the openness to finding a workable arrangement.

Let me summarize where we stand and identify how these two entries interact:

Jordan's conditions: (1) no unscheduled one-to-one contact with Casey, (2) disagreements handled in one 30-minute triad meeting per week, (3) review after exactly 21 days. All three are non-negotiable for Jordan.

Casey's prior agreement: (1) the first exactly four joint meetings will have a neutral facilitator, (2) disagreements recorded in a shared issue log on an ongoing basis.

These seem compatible in principle. The triad meeting Jordan proposes could incorporate the neutral facilitator Casey's agreement calls for. The shared issue log complements the triad meeting structure rather than conflicting with it. And the 21-day review gives us a clear checkpoint.

Before I finalize the arrangement, I want to confirm one thing with each of you. Jordan, are you comfortable with the first four triad meetings serving as the facilitated joint meetings under Casey's prior agreement? Casey, are you comfortable with the shared issue log being maintained as part of the weekly triad meeting structure rather than as a separate process? And to both: does a 21-day review point work for you, Casey, or do you have a different timeline in mind?
